text:
Maya Singh: Hey folks, first-week setup hiccup. Finished OOBE but Kandji shows 'Enrollment stalled: SCEP CSR failed' and Okta device trust keeps prompting but never completes. No DocuSign seen in my inbox. Laptop is M2 Max.

Rafi Gomez: Welcome Maya! I can help. HR should've sent the device agreement. Check spam and the alternate email alias. Which network are you on? Hotel or home? Some captive portals break SCEP.

Maya Singh: On a hotel network right now. I don't have sudo. `fdesetup status` -> FileVault On. I tried disconnecting/reconnecting but same error.

IT Bot: Ticket #RD-ONB-4098 created and assigned to Devices Team.

Devices Team: Hi Maya, we see SCEP timeouts in the logs. Two paths: (1) we resend DocuSign + you sign on an unfiltered network (home or hotspot), or (2) we grant a 90-min temp-admin so you can install the root CA manually and re-run enrollment. Which is easier for you?

Maya Singh: Can I do option 2? I'll be moving between meetings so quicker to get it sorted now.

Devices Team: Temp-admin granted (token id td-992) for 90 minutes. Please run: `curl -fsS -o /tmp/rw-root.crt https://pki.redwood.corp/root.crt && sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /tmp/rw-root.crt` Then re-trigger Kandji enroll. Paste any errors here.

Maya Singh: Ran the command, got "certificate added". Re-ran Kandji enroll and it says 'profile installed' now, but Okta device trust still shows 'policy mismatch' and Zscaler fails to provision.

Rafi Gomez: Okta device trust often needs the machine cert to present. Check `profiles -P` and `sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent status`. Also try restarting Zscaler: `sudo pkill -f zscaler && open -a Zscaler` and re-auth.

Maya Singh: `profiles -P` shows the 802.1X and machine cert present. `kandji-agent status` -> connected. Did the pkill, relaunched Zscaler, completed login, Okta now says device trusted.

Devices Team: Great. Noting temp-admin used; it will auto-revoke at expiry. Any virtualization or kernel-extension prompts? We can push approvals via Kandji if needed.

Maya Singh: Getting a prompt about Rosetta for a legacy tool. Can I run `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` while temp sudo is active?

Rafi Gomez: Approved for the window. If it asks for system extension approval, screenshot and DM Devices Team so we can pre-approve.

Maya Singh: Rosetta installed, Docker & devcontainers working. One last quick question: is it okay to upgrade from macOS 13.4 to 13.5 now or wait?

Devices Team: Minor security updates are fine. We advise holding off on major point releases until your machine matches the CI runner (we're testing 13.5.1 this week). If you want us to patch to a specific build we can schedule it. Welcome aboard!
